name: Sunil Narine
profileSummary: Sunil Philip Narine is a Trinidadian professional cricket right-arm off spinner and left-handed batter who plays for the four Knight Riders franchise teams and the Durban's Super Giants in the SA20. He represented the West Indies in international cricket between 2011 and 2019 where he was part of the squad that won the 2012 World Twenty20. Narine is considered one of the greatest Twenty20 cricketers of all time.
